preconditions.name: enough_divergent_seeds
preconditions.description: the number of seeds whose candidate pool is DIVERGENT on the focus C1 comparison arms (A0 + A2 settling + ARM_NOISE) is >= MIN_DIVERGENT_SEEDS. Per-seed-divergent gating (701a-style): a degenerate cell self-excludes. Too few divergent seeds => substrate_not_ready_requeue (pool too collapsed to test conversion).
preconditions.control: consumed cand_world_summary pairwise spread > floor (GAP-A); per-seed

preconditions.name: matched_noise_control_verified_lifting
preconditions.description: 700c SAME-LAYER null: the ARM_NOISE matched-magnitude FROZEN random W_lat at the eligibility/settling field (the layer MECH-450 settling acts on) lifts committed-class entropy strict-above A0 by margin on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. This is the BETTER-LAYERED bar: a settling-field perturbation is COUPLED to the committed-class DV (the 700b policy-temperature null was DECOUPLED by the F-bounded eligibility constitution and could not verify-lift). Control not verify-lifting => substrate_not_ready_requeue (re-tune the FIELD-NOISE scale, the correct layer -- NOT an alpha bump).
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE committed-class entropy vs A0, divergent seeds, paired

preconditions.name: field_noise_magnitude_matched
preconditions.description: 700d SAME-LAYER null magnitude match: ARM_NOISE's median frozen-random W_lat range is within [FIELD_NOISE_MAGNITUDE_MATCH_LO, FIELD_NOISE_MAGNITUDE_MATCH_HI] x the median LEARNED A2/A3 SIGNED settling-arm W_lat range (the C3 UNSIGNED abs-RPE tail is EXCLUDED) -- and the null is AUTO-RESCALED to that median, so the realised ratio lands ~1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION. measured = the realised ratio. An out-of-band ratio => substrate_not_ready_requeue (the scale is auto-computed; no fixed knob to re-tune).
preconditions.control: median ARM_NOISE wlat_range_max vs median A2/A3 SIGNED learned wlat_range_max

preconditions.name: learned_settling_range_non_vacuous
preconditions.description: 700d near-vacuity guard: the median LEARNED A2/A3 signed-settling W_lat range (the auto-scale match TARGET) must clear LEARNED_RANGE_VACUITY_FLOOR. If the learned settling arms barely move W_lat, a magnitude-matched null tests learned-structure against noise-of-noise (a vacuous match) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict.
preconditions.control: median A2/A3 signed-settling wlat_range_max vs vacuity floor

preconditions.name: same_layer_null_not_destructive
preconditions.description: 700d explicit guard: the magnitude-matched ARM_NOISE must NOT drive committed-class entropy strictly BELOW A0 on a strict-majority of divergent seeds (700c's oversized null drove noise 0.859 < A0 0.909). measured = the count of divergent seeds whose noise entropy is NOT below A0 (FLOOR on the not-below count). A destructive null cannot serve as the verify-lifting floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE committed-class entropy vs A0, divergent seeds, paired (not-below count)

preconditions.name: delta_t_carries_variance_on_learning_arms
preconditions.description: the signed-RPE delta_t (= benefit_eval - harm_eval - V-hat_t; OR the unsigned abs ARC-016 variance on C3_SETTLING_UNSIGNED) carries cross-tick STD above floor on a majority of seeds on the settling-armed (A2, A3, C3) arms AND the w_chan-armed (A3) arm -- there is outcome variance to learn from. Flat => substrate_not_ready_requeue (the C3 unsigned arm flat is STARVED, not 'unsigned fails').
preconditions.control: wlat_delta_t_std (A2/A3/C3) + lcg_delta_t_std (A3) on the armed arms

preconditions.name: learned_weights_moved_from_init_on_armed_arms
preconditions.description: W_lat range > floor AND the settling MOVED the field (learned_settling_round_delta > floor) on the settling-armed arms (A2, A3, C3; zero init => range 0) AND w_chan range > floor on the w_chan-armed arm (A3; softplus-unity init => range 0). Weights never moving => eligibility never credited => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent_focus_arms
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds in the focus arms (GAP-A non-vacuity). This is the per-seed divergence the gating reads.
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

terminal_escalation: V4 ARC-110 loop-segregation substrate (implement-substrate); NO further V3 letters (a valid-null verify-lift with no learned-settling lift trips the brake-LOCK)

re_derive_brake.rationale: user-adjudicated 2026-06-26 (Reading B): 700c was an invalid-precondition self-route (magnitude-mismatched 41.42x null), NOT a clean ceiling -- so the brake did not fire. 700d is a measurement-VALIDITY fix (auto-magnitude-match the same-layer null + vacuity/below-A0 guards), the same class as 704->704b and 705->705b, and is the ONE validity-fixed letter the brake-LOCK permits.
re_derive_brake.brake_lock: the NEXT 700-lineage result with a VALID magnitude-matched same-layer null that still shows no learned-settling lift FIRES the brake -> V4 ARC-110 loop-segregation, no more V3 letters
re_derive_brake.refuses: any further same-lever requeue on a valid-null no-lift

same_layer_null.layer: eligibility/settling field (_modulatory_accum[eligible_idx], the layer MECH-450 W_lat settling acts on)
same_layer_null.mechanism: frozen random W_lat with learned_settling_eta=0.0, AUTO-RESCALED so its range == FIELD_NOISE_TARGET_RATIO x the in-run median LEARNED A2/A3 signed-settling W_lat range (700d validity re-tune; 700c used a fixed scale 0.5 -> 41.42x overshoot). Gated behind per-arm field_noise so A0/A2/A3/C3 stay byte-identical to 700b/700c.

evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-700d ARC-108 sec-7 LEARNED-GATING CONVERSION FALSIFIER -- VALIDITY RE-TUNE of the SAME-LAYER null (experiment_purpose=evidence; claim_ids=[MECH-439, ARC-108, MECH-450]; supersedes V3-EXQ-700c). Routed by the user-adjudicated (Reading B) failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-700c_2026-06-26: 700c's same-layer frozen-random W_lat null came in 41.42x the realised learned settling range (median noise 2.16 vs learned 0.052; field_noise_magnitude_matched band [0.25,4.0] FAILED) and drove committed-class entropy BELOW A0 (0.859 vs 0.909; noise_verified_lifting 0/3) -- a calibration artifact, the V3-EXQ-642 invalid-precondition family (same shape as 704's 176.9x). THE ONE CHANGE FROM 700c (config only; no ree_core change): the frozen-random W_lat scale is no longer a fixed 0.5 -- it is AUTO-COMPUTED at run time so the injected range equals FIELD_NOISE_TARGET_RATIO (1.0) x the in-run median LEARNED W_lat range of the A2/A3 SIGNED settling arms ONLY (the C3 UNSIGNED arm's abs-RPE blow-up to range 1.9-4.8 is excluded from both the match target and the magnitude-match denominator). A near-vacuity guard (median A2/A3 learned range must clear LEARNED_RANGE_VACUITY_FLOOR) and an explicit below-A0 destructive-null guard now self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than scoring. All 700c design is retained (5 arms, settling layer, matched arithmetic envelope, reef-bipartite size 12, phased P0/P1/P2, committed-action-class entropy DV; A0/A2/A3/C3 byte-identical to 700b/700c). RE-DERIVE BRAKE EXEMPT (autopsy: invalid-precondition, not a clean ceiling; the ONE validity-fixed letter the brake-LOCK permits, same class as 704->704b / 705->705b). PRE-REGISTERED TERMINAL for the validity question: a magnitude-matched null that VERIFY-LIFTS while learned settling still does NOT lift -> escalate V4 ARC-110 loop-segregation (no more V3 letters; TRIPS the brake-LOCK). PROMOTES NOTHING (MECH-439 substrate_ceiling; ARC-108/MECH-450 substrate_conditional; pending_retest_after_substrate). outcome=FAIL; label=substrate_not_ready_requeue; per_claim={'MECH-439': 'non_contributory', 'ARC-108': 'non_contributory', 'MECH-450': 'non_contributory'}.

interpretation_grid.PASS_learned_gating_converts_where_arith: preconditions met (ENOUGH divergent seeds + VERIFIED-LIFTING SAME-LAYER noise bar + magnitude-matched + learning engaged) AND C1 (a settling arm committed-class entropy strict-above BOTH A0 and the verified same-layer noise control on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds) AND C2 (the lift GROWS over training + the learned weights moved). The learned recurrent settling step (MECH-450 W_lat) -- and/or the learned channel re-weighting (ARC-108 w_chan via A3) -- CONVERTS committed-action diversity where the pure-arithmetic envelope (and a matched RANDOM settling-field perturbation) plateaus -> supports MECH-439 (ceiling liftable) + the learning claim(s). C3 (signed-RPE load-bearing): if C3a (signed converts) AND C3b (unsigned fails) with the unsigned arm engaged, the SIGN of the RPE is load-bearing -> ARC-108 supports; if the unsigned arm ALSO converts, route back to ARC-016 (ARC-108 mixed). PROMOTES NOTHING here (substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional).
interpretation_grid.PASS_static_reweighting_fold_into_arithm: preconditions met AND C1 (converts) BUT NOT C2 (the lift is present from tick 0 and does NOT grow with training). The conversion is a STATIC re-weighting, not learning -> MECH-439 supports (ceiling liftable) but ARC-108 / MECH-450 are MIXED; fold the winning static weights into the arithmetic lever, do NOT mint a learning claim.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_no_lift_preconditions_met_escalate_: DECISIVE. preconditions met (learning engaged, weights moved, ENOUGH divergent seeds, the SAME-LAYER null VERIFIED-LIFTING + magnitude-matched) BUT NO entropy lift over A0/noise on the settling arms. The SAME-LAYER null verify-lifts AND the learned settling arms do NOT beat it => learned STRUCTURE adds nothing over a matched random settling-field perturbation at the same layer -> escalate to the V4 full BG-thalamo-cortical loop / loop-segregation (no more V3 letters; this run is PRE-REGISTERED TERMINAL). This is NOT a falsification of ARC-107 (the arithmetic envelope still holds) and does NOT promote learned gating. non_contributory for all claims.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: 700d VALIDITY RE-TUNE (the ONE letter the brake-LOCK permits). A precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds (pool collapsed), OR delta_t flat (no outcome variance), OR the learned weights never moved / the settling never moved the field, OR the median LEARNED A2/A3 signed W_lat range is BELOW the vacuity floor (a magnitude-matched null would test learned-structure against noise-of-noise), OR the auto-magnitude-matched SAME-LAYER null did not VERIFY-LIFT above A0 on a strict-majority of divergent seeds / DROVE entropy BELOW A0 (destructive null), OR the realised match ratio fell outside [LO,HI] (the auto-scale failed to land in band). The conversion question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification. The null scale is now AUTO-COMPUTED from the in-run learned A2/A3 range (no fixed scale to re-tune); a persistent failure to verify-lift / match magnitude / clear vacuity at the correct layer ESCALATES to V4 ARC-110 loop-segregation, NEVER another V3 letter (this TRIPS the brake-LOCK).
